reason: I post in my apartment WhatsApp group and go with whoever a neighbour vouches for -- I don't go hunting on apps for a plumber or a salon person. Unless someone in my group has actually used this and said it worked out, it's just another app icon to me.
objection: What happens if the person doesn't show up or does a shoddy job -- do I actually get my money back, or am I stuck arguing with customer care?
would_change_my_mind: If a neighbour in my WhatsApp group had already used it and said the freelancer showed up and did the job properly, or if the app clearly spelled out a no-show/bad-work refund policy -- then I'd try it once.
